title: Rent-a-Girlfriend
description: Rent a GirlfriendKinoshita Kazuya is a 20-year-old failure of a college student. He managed to kiss his girlfriend once, but was dumped after a month. Completely spiteful, Kazuya uses a certain method to date a girl. He goes to their meeting place and a beautiful girl brushing her long, black hair behind her ear was there, smiling at him. Her name was Mizuhara Chizuru. Something real is born after just a single rental! A reckless rom-com filled with love and excitement is about to begin!

episodes.title: S4-E9For My First Time and Girlfriend

episodes_data.title: Rent-a-Girlfriend Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Jilted and heartbroken, 20-year-old Kinoshita Kazuya turns to Diamond, a Rent-A-Girlfriend app that leads him to a fateful encounter with Mizuhara Chizuru, one of the talents on offer.

episodes_data.title: Rent-a-Girlfriend Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Immediately after deciding not to rely on pretend dating anymore, Kazuya is hit with a triple whammy of reveals: Chizuru not only goes to his college but lives next door to him, and his grandmother is coming to visit and wants to see her.

episodes_data.title: Rent-a-Girlfriend Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Kazuya barely has time to deal with the fallout of the situation in the pub before the gang heads off on a short trip to Izu, where they run into someone unexpected.

episodes_data.title: Rent-a-Girlfriend Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Mami’s plan comes to a head as Kazuya decides to set the story straight, to mixed reactions.

episodes_data.title: Rent-a-Girlfriend Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: The aftermath of the ferry incident signals a clear shift in Kazuya’s feelings. Meanwhile, there’s a conspiracy brewing at the hot springs inn he and his family decide to visit.

episodes_data.title: Rent-a-Girlfriend Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Having to spend a night in the same room with Chizuru sends Kazuya’s heart and mind racing. Meanwhile, Kuribayashi Shun has a surprise in store…

episodes_data.title: Rent-a-Girlfriend Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: While Kazuya desperately tries to get Ruka to promise she won’t reveal his secret, she tells him her own.

episodes_data.title: Rent-a-Girlfriend Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Christmas rolls around with Kazuya not having met Chizuru for ages, and he sees something he never wanted to see.

episodes_data.title: Rent-a-Girlfriend Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Ruka is hellbent on knowing the full story behind Kazuya and Chizuru’s relationship, and once she does she decides to take action.

episodes_data.title: Rent-a-Girlfriend Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Kazuya learns that Kuribayashi's been down in the dumps and tries to figure out how he can help him.

episodes_data.title: Rent-a-Girlfriend Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: On Chizuru's request, Kazuya goes on a practice date with Sumi, another rental girlfriend. Will he actually be able to help her and stay out of trouble while he's at it?

episodes_data.title: Rent-a-Girlfriend Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Chizuru and Mami go on an awkward rental date unaware that Kazuya has seen them together. How can Chizuru handle this situation?

episodes_data.title: Rent-a-Girlfriend Season 4 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Kazuya suggests that he and Chizuru get lunch together. How will she take it?
